196699097.title: File:1965 VW Beetle Sedan AVI2387 Engine - 55437653570.jpg

ImageDescription.value: 1967 Volkswagen 1300 Deluxe sedan engine. VW Australia continued to press their own panels using the small window body style superceded in 1965. Australian content reached 95% by 1967, the last year that VW Australia used their own pressing facilities. For 1968 the cars were imported CKD or fully assembled. Taken at the 2013 Shannon's Eastern Creek Classic display day, held at Sydney Motorsport Park.
